messages:
marie: Quick thread to lock the next micro-iteration after last release. We have four candidate slices: 1) embed regression fix (customer blocker), 2) model-level cache toggle + perf win, 3) convo-history small UX tidy, 4) CSV analytics export for pilot customers. Need 1 owner per slice + acceptance criteria by EOD.
liam: customer blocking on embeds is urgent. I'd push that to P0.
tasha: Agreed. CS reports rising tickets and SLA risk.
samir: Cache work looks highest ROI for infra cost but touches prefix cache runtime; risk is medium. If we scope to single heavy model, we can canary quickly.
olga: UX tidy is tiny (design ~2d, eng ~2d) but not high impact vs regression. Export is useful for sales pilots but lower urgency.
marie: Proposed stack: A=embed fix P0, B=cache P1 (single-model canary), C=UX P2, D=export backlog. Anyone object? :thumbsup::thumbsdown:
liam: +1.
tasha: +1.
samir: I'll take B (cache). Will do RFC + feature flag per-model.
liam: I'll own A (embed). Will need eng help for tests.
olga: I'll help with E2E tests for A. Acceptance criteria suggestion for A: reproduce with customer payload, add regression unit + e2e, canary rollout 10% for 72h with zero new regressions, customer comms drafted.
marie: Good. Please put checklist in GH issue and link here.
liam: Creating GH issue now. Draft checklist:
```
- [ ] Reproduce with customer example
- [ ] RCA written
- [ ] Patch PR + unit tests
- [ ] Integration / E2E test added
- [ ] Canary deploy (10%) 72h stable
- [ ] Postmortem + customer update
```
samir: For cache (B) plan: prototype 10d, canary 7d if scoped. I'll add a per-model flag so rollback is trivial. Config example: `cache.{model_name}.enabled = true`
marie: Timeline ask from customer: ETA within 3 weeks. Can we commit?
liam: Optimistic: 1 week if root cause is input handling; pessimistic: 3+ weeks if it's infra-level.
samir: Cache won't block embed fix. We can run in parallel. Prototype in 2w, canary 1w after.
tasha: I'll draft comms with a banded ETA (1wk optimistic / 3wk conservative) and loop legal if needed.
marie: Owners: A->liam (+olga help + tasha comms), B->samir (+aj deploy help), C->olga (owns design), D->marie (sales liaison). Expected update cadence: daily in this thread until A is canaried.
comm-bot: Created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4822 :white_check_mark:
liam: Starting triage now, will post failing logs & repro steps in the issue.
samir: I'll draft the RFC for the cache toggle today and include rollout plan + metrics (p99 latency, token cost delta).
olga: For UX (C) — I'll book 2d design and then handoff to eng for a single sprint.
marie: Quick risk callout: if embed RCA shows model regression (vs our infra), we need to coordinate with model-onboarding and may delay. Keep that as a dependency.
liam: noted. If model side, we'll raise to platform team and inform customer.
tasha: tagging #support to track incoming tickets and reduce duplicates.
marie: OK. Action items: liam GH issue link here, samir RFC link here, olga design slot booked. Reconvene Friday 10am PT for checkpoint. Ping me or #eng-oncall for blockers. :rocket:
thread_text_snippet: Lock micro-iteration: decide owners + acceptance criteria for embed regression, cache perf flag, UX tidy, and analytics export
